propositions: AGENTS.md must state the policy that rebar tracker operations require the MCP server, with an explicit carve-out for local-code operations (testing, investigation, debugging, validation)
Certified operations (plan-review and completion-verifier only) route through MCP and are enforceable via the trusted-env mechanism; code review is the Gerrit LLM-Review vote, not an op-cert

docs/mcp-auth.md section 7 must document the AWS deployment recipe using the ADR-decided config keys (http_tls_at_edge, auth_static_tokens_file, auth_strategies) with nginx TLS edge and per-client bearer token

The AGENTS.md umbrella rule must govern downstream guidance surfaces (docs/, templates/, .agents/rules/, packaged guides, skills) by reference, with a follow-up ticket for per-file reconciliation of non-doc surfaces
Certified-op enforcement must be described as enableable but deferred, not live, with citation to the mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip.md runbook
docs/mcp-auth.md must link to docs/mcp-client-setup.md to surface client configuration shapes (copilot, codex, claude)
